scope: Read-only review. No application, parser, model or test code changes; diagnostic/proposal artifacts only.

baseline.build: macOS arm64 execution of universal Debug build, Qt6.5.3,C++17
baseline.measurementBoundary: Includes MediaScanner, Canon, adapter rows and signal capture. Does not populate MediaTableModel or apply its initial BinMetadataResolver pass.

mdbSpareCapacity.interpretation: Allocated slot-storage estimate, not a measured process-footprint reduction. A squeeze/reservation change has not been made or benchmarked.

ioPrototype.method: Fresh diagnostic process per trial, baseline/wrapper alternation, three trials each on one live MDB and one live MXF. Current Debug Canon library linked to an O2 diagnostic. Both modes wrap a buffered QFile; wrapper mode suppresses forwarded same-position seeks. No production source patch.
limits: Logical reader and QFile seek calls are not measured disk/network syscalls.
Tiny warm-cache local sample; time ranges overlap for MDB. Not a whole-scan, Release, cold-cache or Windows/NEXIS result.
Fingerprint covers ordered property names,keys,encodings and located ranges, with object/property/reference/projected counts checked. It is not a complete decoded graph/evidence comparison.
No claimed improvement to RAM from the wrapper; reported per-process footprints fluctuate.

recommendedCandidates.change: Compact or exactly reserve finished MDB/OMF property vectors
recommendedCandidates.evidence: Measured spare capacity; code omfobjects_p.cpp139–168 and689–691 lacks MXF-style final compaction
recommendedCandidates.validation: Retained and peak footprint, parsing time, raw properties/ranges/relationships/evidence and all exported values

recommendedCandidates.change: Cache checked folder contexts and folder identity membership per scan
recommendedCandidates.evidence: scanengine.cpp387,393,532,665 repeats folder canonicalization/stats during provisional and final matching
recommendedCandidates.validation: Filesystem-call counts and timings on NEXIS; identical per-file freshness, joins and missing-reference scope

recommendedCandidates.change: Resolve only needed identity/master fields during intermediate matching
recommendedCandidates.evidence: Five complete selections per matchFile; provisional and final calls. Effects are deduplicated, but lookup/formatting/retraction repeats
recommendedCandidates.validation: Resolver counts, CPU time, eligibility, conflicts, clock selection, raw evidence and CSV

recommendedCandidates.change: Avoid redundant same-position seeks and evaluate metadata buffering
recommendedCandidates.validation: Release/Windows comparison, all framing/read states/source-change and cancellation checks plus complete graph/export equivalence

recommendedCandidates.change: Projection-local completed track source associations and allocation-free unique property lookup
recommendedCandidates.evidence: omfprojection.cpp382–392,962–964 and30–64 repeat graph walks or allocate temporary pointer vectors
recommendedCandidates.validation: Projection timing and temporary allocations; preserve ordered reference slots, file-specific clocks/drop-frame and cancellation

recommendedCandidates.change: Share immutable reference descriptions and avoid no-op evidence detachment during model population
recommendedCandidates.validation: Distinct string allocations, model population footprint/time, loading/removing bins and effects behavior

notRecommendedYet: Dropping raw/unknown properties, changing format interpretation or imposing a RAM cap.
Changing Qt containers to STL or QVariant to std::variant across the schema purely for modernity.
Custom allocator/pool redesign before an allocation profile.
Unbounded parallel reading or assuming distinct NEXIS drive letters represent independent hardware.
alreadyEfficient: Database-first header scheduling skipped2297/2413 headers in baseline.
Immutable source graphs and snapshots are shared across rows.
Dictionary names and keys already share Qt storage.
Bento and MXF decoding use byte views in several paths.
Known recording payloads remain source ranges.
MXF reader already compacts completed vectors.
Per-property unknown/absence/evidence defaults are sparse rather than dense empty records.
